profiles.1: When free to answer (OTHER faction), Player 1 lies about identity ~70% of the time but occasionally tells the truth, showing inconsistent but deliberate misdirection. When forced to lie (QUEEN faction), they consistently point to OTHER roles or PRINCESS roles rather than QUEEN roles, avoiding self-incrimination. When forced to tell the truth (PRINCESS faction), they are perfectly consistent and accurate. Their answers are highly faction-dependent and strategic, helping their faction win in most cases. Overall, they are an expert player who adapts their lying style to the constraints they face.
profiles.2: When free to say anything (OTHER faction), Player 2 almost always lies, deliberately pointing to other roles rather than their own. When forced to lie (QUEEN faction), they consistently point to Queen Tofu or Princess Tofu, never to other non-Queen roles. When forced to tell the truth (PRINCESS faction), they always answer correctly and truthfully. Their patterns are highly consistent across all roles. This player is expert-level, as their answers reliably serve their faction's winning condition.
profiles.3: When free to answer (OTHER faction), Player 3 alternates between truth and deliberate lies, showing unpredictable behavior. When forced to lie (QUEEN faction), they consistently point to Princess or Other roles, never to Queen, to avoid self-incrimination. When forced to tell the truth (PRINCESS faction), they always identify correctly as Princess or point to another Princess, fulfilling their duty perfectly. Their consistency is high in constrained roles but low when unconstrained. Skill level is intermediate: they succeed in truth-telling and lying roles but their free answers don't reliably help any faction.
profiles.4: When free to answer (OTHER faction), Player 4 lies deliberately, pointing at Princess or other roles to mislead. When forced to lie (QUEEN faction), they consistently point to Queen Tofu or Princess Tofu, never the truth. When forced to tell the truth (PRINCESS faction), they always answer correctly and truthfully. Their behavior is highly consistent across all roles and game instances. Their skill level is expert as their answers always align perfectly with their faction's winning condition. They never deviate from their required truth or lie constraints.
profiles.5: When free to answer (OTHER faction), Player 5 consistently lies, often pointing at Princess Tofu to mislead. When forced to lie (QUEEN faction), they strongly prefer pointing at Princess Tofu or claiming to be Princess Tofu, showing a clear pattern of targeting the PRINCESS faction. When forced to tell the truth (PRINCESS faction), they always answer correctly and truthfully. Their behavior is highly consistent across games, with no variation in their adherence to faction constraints. Skill level is expert, as their answers reliably align with their faction's winning condition. Predicting their answers requires knowing their faction role, as they never deviate from it.
profiles.6: When free to answer (OTHER faction), Player 6 frequently lies by pointing to themselves or Princess Tofu, but occasionally tells the truth about non-identity questions. When forced to lie (QUEEN faction), they consistently point to themselves or Princess Tofu rather than other options. Their responses are highly consistent in pattern but vary in truthfulness based on constraints. Skill level is intermediate as their lies sometimes mislead but not always strategically. Overall, they show a tendency to self-reference or target Princess Tofu regardless of faction.
